params.body:
## Why

The source links of a designed report lead through Gentells since 19 November 2026, but only as a link laid over what the designers printed. The page a reader sees still names each publisher's own address, and finding those addresses in a design made elsewhere is a guess each time: one report set them inside a sentence and the step found one source of nine.

## What

The pages that hold the designers' source list are taken out and the list is set in their place, from the sources held for the report (`packages/core/report-source-pages.mjs`).

- Each entry: its number, the publisher, the title, the date, and the address of its page on gentells.com. The whole entry is the link, and the address printed is the address it opens.
- No publisher's address is left on those pages. A remark in the date field is not printed; a date reads as a day, a month or a year.
- The page is plain: paper, no picture, the report's own page size, two columns on a landscape page and one on an upright one. The pages before and after are not touched.
- Every held source is on the list, also one whose address the old step could not find in the design.
- Links in the body of the report are repointed as before (`report-stamp.mjs`).

**Never on a guess.** A page is replaced only when it carries a source heading and addresses of the list were found on it, or when three or more were. A contents page that only names "Sources" stays. When no page qualifies, nothing is replaced, the stamped links stand, and the outcome line says so.

**Reversible.** The designers' file is kept as it came and the outgoing file is made from it each time, as before.

`stampStoredReport` now does this on upload, after a change to the held sources, and from `bin/stamp-reports.mjs`. Its summary carries `replaced` (the designers' pages taken out) and `list_pages`.

## Added to the repository

- `@pdf-lib/fontkit`, to embed a font in the file.
- `packages/core/fonts/`: IBM Plex Sans Regular and SemiBold, and Newsreader Regular (Latin, for the heading only), each under the SIL Open Font License, with the licence texts beside them. The standard PDF fonts cannot set names outside Western European.

To weigh: the list page has one look for every report, Gentells's own, whatever the design of the report around it.

## Checked

- `test/report-source-pages.test.mjs`: the list stands in place of the designers' page, in order, each entry printed with and linked to its Gentells address; no publisher's address is left; the body and the back cover are untouched and the page keeps its size; a name with Polish letters is set; a remark in the date field is not printed; two addresses on a page without a heading do not make it a source page; nothing held or an unreadable file leaves the file alone.
- Rehearsed on the designers' files of The New Status System (pages 26 to 28 replaced by 3) and Going Out, Staying In (page 21 replaced by 2), with the real keys.
- Full suite 1805/1805, `tsc` clean.
- Not rehearsed on the other reports on the shelf: their files are not on the workbench. The dry run below shows them before anything is written.

## After merge, on the box

```bash
npm ci
node bin/stamp-reports.mjs --dry     # per report: which pages would be replaced
node bin/stamp-reports.mjs
```
params.title: A report's source list is set again by Gentells
